subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the same sequence in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

SX_ABS_YBBSXY_BSX_DB
solution:
Given: SX_ABS_YBBSXY_BSX_DB 

Let's check each option:

 
• XCCY → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb6dc24b44b147646a0ff646d827f76353279da236ce6e389d4499c7915fac1d.png] 
 
• CXYX → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08adce62fde04c14219c086a9cd7665fb9b29b4995b5bc54e27b92ceba28705a.png] 
 
• **YXCY ****→ ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3254d14f4004c5284adc7646d41757554adc5bf9dd059892ab6bdbdbd98d02b.png] 
 
• XCYC → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/110890246ccc849ca653152bcc4bed5b8373d5f0f437fef63209fd70858057ce.png] 

​So, by putting** option 3 in the series 'SXYA, B, C, DB is repeating itself.**

Hence, **the correct answer is "YXCY".**
